title: Custom agent frontmatter (.github/agents/*.agent.md)
description: YAML frontmatter contract for VS Code Copilot custom-agent files. Enforced by .github/scripts/validate-instructions.ps1 (frontmatter sanity, section 4).

description.description: One-line summary of the agent's purpose and when to invoke it.

tools.description: Optional whitelist of tools the agent may use. Omit to inherit the workspace default. Recommended for read-only or scoped agents.
